events.name: Monster Jam
events.info: Experience Monster Jam live and become a fan for life. With awesome trucks, amazing stunts, action-packed excitement and big air, its the definition of fun for everyone! Watch as 12,000lb trucks stand on two wheels and fly through the air. Plus, youll be in the middle of the action, as you get to score the drivers in real time based on their skills, stunts and saves. See the worlds most popular trucks like Grave Digger, El Toro Loco, Sparkle Smash and more only at Monster Jam. As Big As It Gets!
events.pleaseNote: -All guests age 2 & older are required to have a ticket. -No costumes for guests 14 & older. -Please monitor the venue website for venue policies, including health and safety protocols, which are subject to change. -All tickets are subject to availability. -Prices & Competitors are subject to change. -Monster Jam Trackside begins approximately one hour before the event start time and features: o Competition Preview o Driver Interviews o Behind the Scenes with the Pit Crew o Judges Zone Overview o Opening Ceremonies o Giveaways o Power Rush Truck Introductions Theres no better way to get ready for the action, so get to your seats early to experience all the family fun. -Visit MonsterJam.com for more event info and Ticket Terms and Conditions.

venues.name: CHI Health Center Omaha

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: Box office: (402) 341-1500 For group information call: (402) 599-6818. For Ticketmaster order inquiries: 800-653-8000
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Cash, Visa, MasterCard, Discover, & American Express. Checks are not accepted.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets can be picked up no earlier that 2 hours prior to the performance at the Box Office Will Call window. Customer must present the actual credit card used for the order, a valid picture ID, and the confirmation number. Customer must sign for tickets. Tickets will only be given to cardholder, no alternate persons picking up tickets will be allowed.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking is located on the west and north sides of the facility for a fee.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is located on both the Lower Bowl and Upper Bowl. The arena has elevators and/or escalators to reach all levels. Assistive Listening Devices are available at the Guest Services area on the South side of the Arena Main Concourse. Customer must leave a driver s license or credit card that will be held until device is returned. 1 Accessible/1 Companion allowed at this venue.

generalInfo.generalRule: Bag Policy: Our arena has a Clear Bag Policy. Only clear, uncolored plastic tote-bags will be permitted into the facility. Or guests may carry one opaque clutch-sized purse or wallet, not exceeding 4.5 inches tall by 6.5 inches long. Bags that do not meet these guidelines must be discarded or returned to a vehicle. CHI Health Center staff members are not permitted to hold or store bags on the premises. Cameras and recording devices are not allowed in the facility, but may vary on an event by event basis. Please contact Box Office for more information. Outside food or beverage is not allowed. CHI Health Center Omaha is a smoke free facility. Patrons may be subject to security checks.
generalInfo.childRule: For most events everyone needs a ticket. For shows intended for young audiences please check event or call the Box Office regarding ages allowed on lap.

venues.name: Baxter Arena

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: To purchase tickets, please call Ticketmaster at 800-745-3000
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Monday - Friday, 12:00 PM to 5:00 PM Evening, weekend, and holiday hours vary according to event schedules.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Cash, Visa, MasterCard, Discover, & American Express
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call will open 2 hours prior to an event. Customer must present the credit card used to make the purchase, as well as a valid photo ID. Tickets will only be given to the person whose name is on the order.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking at arena is free; Multiple lots surrounding arena; Parking garage across the street
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: WHEELCHAIR ACCESS: Accessible seating is located in both the upper and lower bowl. HEARING IMPAIRED: Assistive Listening Devices are available at the Guest Services table on the south side of the main concourse. A valid ID is required to ensure the return of equipment. ELEVATOR ACCESS: Elevators are located at each entrance. The elevator nearest the south entrance provides access to the ground level and first floor, while the elevator nearest the north entrance provides access to the ground level, first and second floors.

generalInfo.generalRule: DOORS OPEN: 1 hour prior to event CAMERAS: For most events, small point and shoot cameras are allowed. Professional cameras, specifically cameras with professional/detachable lenses and flash, are not permitted. Baxter Arena reserves the right to examine and prohibit the use of any camera entering the venue. RECORDING DEVICES: Audio and video recording is prohibited during all events.
generalInfo.childRule: Most events do not require a ticket for children under the age of two. However, in order for a child to have their own seat, a ticket will be required. Note that some shows intended for young children require all attendees to have a ticket. To inquire about specific events, please call 402.554.6200.
